name: Species One
summary:
Mobians are one of the most widespread and populous races in Mobius along with humans. They are anthropomorphic animals, encompassing countless species: hedgehogs, wolves, birds, reptiles, insects, aquatic creatures.... Any animal you can imagine can be a Mobian. 

They can be found on nearly every continent and in almost every nation, forming the backbone of many cultures, societies, and conflicts.
The exact origin of Mobians is unknown. They are native to the planet, evolving naturally over millennia alongside humans and other intelligent races. Ancient ruins, murals, and records suggest Mobians have existed since prehistoric times, long before modern civilizations formed.

quote.speaker: Walpurgis
quote.text: "And these ones? Where do they come from?"

quote.speaker: Argus
quote.text: "Further back than anyone still alive can tell you."

parts.text:
Mobians are extremely abundant and globally distributed.

Although some species of Mobians are more common in certain parts of a planet than in others, the population is fairly distributed. So it's not unusual to find a kangaroo in Eurish or a polar bear in Shamar.

In Moebius these species are called Moebians, while in Sol they are called Solians.
